messages:
alex: AP-SE2 reporting sustained GPU evictions across two pods + intermittent network flap to core switch. Queue depth up ~4x, tail latencies spiking. Need emergency rate-limiting plan.
ops-bot: [ALERT] ap-se2-gpu-1 group: eviction_rate=83%, net_errors=high over 5m, queue_depth=critical.
ravi: seeing redis churn on inference-cache; backpressure not propagating. Large streaming sessions from a few tenants (T-108, T-402) are top contributors.
maria: propose soft caps per-customer: concurrent request cap -> 60% for top 8 tenants, 30% for untagged bursters. Token-rate caps for streaming jobs too. Also consider routing new traffic to ap-northeast fallback.
jules: agree on soft caps. AP-NORTHEAST has limited spare GPUs, so prefer capped routing for customers who have geo-fallback enabled.
alex: action items: 1) apply per-customer softcaps (start with top 8 tenants) 2) route traffic for geo-fallback customers to ap-northeast 3) CS to notify impacted customers and add note to status page. If no improvement in 20m -> escalate to hard caps.
ops-bot: initiating quota update: POST /internal/quotas/apply payload -> {policy: "softcap", region: "ap-se2", targets: ["T-108","T-402","T-319",...], concurrency_pct: 60, token_rps: 100} 
alex: infractl command for ops if needed:
```
infractl quota set --region ap-se2 --customer $CUSTOMER_ID --concurrency-pct 60 --token-rps 100
```
ravi: rolling changes now. Started with 8 tenants in parallel (stagger 10s). Observed queue depth begin to drop after first batch.
maria: enabling tenant-level KV prefix caching for the heavy tenants to reduce repeated decoding cost. Small config toggle, should be immediate.
jules: cost note: cross-region routing to ap-northeast will incur egress + inter-region charges and load on that pool. Rough estimate if sustained >2h: ~$2k/hr. Flagging for finance/eng leadership.
cs: drafting customer-facing note now. Will ping account owners for high-touch customers. Status page update queued under incidents->ap-se2.
alex: monitoring: focus on queue_depth, 95p latency, eviction_rate, net_errs. If metrics don't trend down in 20m, prepare to apply hard caps to top 5 tenants (40% concurrency).
ops-bot: metrics snapshot (7m after): queue_depth -30%, 95p_latency -22%, eviction_rate -50%, network_errors trending down.
ravi: steady improvement. Lowered concurrency to 50% for two heaviest tenants as extra relief. No customer-facing breaking changes (soft cap only).
alex: keeping softcaps in place while we validate for 1h. Post-incident actions: update runbook (add play for per-region quota rollouts, infractl rollback tests), run a table-top for network+eviction combos. Assign to ravi/jules.
jules: will open PR with runbook edits and a small infractl test harness. tagging @maria for cache config notes. :thumbsup: 
cs: all affected customers notified via email + slack DMs, support routing enabled. Monitoring channel will remain open until green.
ops-bot: closing loop: softcap policy applied -> active. Will post final metrics in 30m.
